name: Connacht

language.note: Ireland's census asks which foreign languages a person speaks and whether they can speak Irish. Neither is a breakdown of the population by language: the first excludes English speakers, the second counts an ability.

sources.name: CSO Census 2022 (Ireland), SAPMAP local electoral areas

adapter_hint: CSO Census 2022 via PxStat (SAPMAP religion and ethnicity by local electoral area): python -m scripts.fetch_census.ireland
religion_note: Summed from all 26 second-level divisions; no source publishes this figure for the unit itself. Their populations total 608,888 against a published 589,338 for the unit. The unit's own published population of 589,338 disagrees with that by +3%; the sum was taken anyway because every division at this level in the country carries these figures, so these are certainly all of its children.
population_note: Summed from all 26 second-level divisions. Replaces a separately published 589,338 for 2022, which is kept here as the only independent check on this sum.
ethnicity_note: Summed from all 26 second-level divisions; no source publishes this figure for the unit itself. Their populations total 608,888 against a published 608,888 for the unit.
